sources.citation: Person, Kirk R. 2007. A preliminary phonological sketch of Pyen, with comparison to Bisu. In Iwasaki Shoichi, Andrew Simpson, Karen Adams & Paul Sidwell (eds.), SEALS XIII: Papers from the 13th Annual Meeting of the Southeast Asian Linguistics Society (2003), 193-201. Canberra: Pacific Linguistics.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. Read in full (pp.193-201: syllable structure, consonants, vowels, tone, conclusion). States syllable = C1(C2)V T(C3) with obligatory tone, and 'three contrastive tones, low, mid, and high' (p.199); no mention of stress/accent anywhere.
